description: This bar chart illustrates the GLUE Performance for various Fine-tuning Methods, comparing two RoBERTa model sizes—“base” (blue) and “large” (orange)—across seven different methods: Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S₁-model, S₄-model, and S₅-model. The horizontal axis represents the Fine-tuning Method, with categories labeled in order from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled “GLUE Performance” and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 85 to 89, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 0.5 units, though the axis labels shown are 86 and 88. Each method has two adjacent bars, with the “large” model consistently performing higher than the “base” model in all cases. The performance values are approximately: Prefix (base: ~85.2, large: ~85.8), Adaptor (base: ~85.1, large: ~88.1), LoRA (base: ~87.1, large: ~88.8), BitFit (base: ~85.0, large: ~87.8), S₁-model (base: ~85.5, large: ~85.5), S₄-model (base: ~86.3, large: ~87.7), and S₅-model (base: ~87.5, large: ~89.0). The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the fine-tuning methods listed on the x-axis. There are no visual emphasis elements such as shading, bolding, or annotations on any bars.
